items.title: 12.1 Nucleus ka structure (banawat) aur properties (khoobiyan) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 12.1 (PDF 262) in the book's order, with a table and a self-check.

blocks.text: Hum maante hain ke tamam atoms neutrons, protons aur electrons se bane hain. In teenon ke antiparticles (ulte zarre) bhi maloom hain. Positron (positive electron), neutrino aur photon bhi maloom hain. 1960s ke aakhir tak neutron aur proton jaise bohat se naye particles (zarre) discover (daryaft) hue. Inhein mesons kaha gaya; in ke masses zyada tar nucleons se kam magar electron se zyada the. Baad mein aise mesons bhi mile jin ke masses nucleons se zyada hain. Physicists ne aur zyada fundamental (bunyadi) particles dhoondhne shuru kiye jo in se bhi chhote hisson se bane hon; experiments (tajurbon) ne is ko confirm (pakka) kiya, aur in chhote hisson ko quarks kaha gaya. Is chapter mein hum matter (maadde) ke basic building blocks (bunyadi eenton) ko parhenge.

Atom ka nucleus do qism ke particles (zarron) se bana hai: protons aur neutrons. Proton sab se simple (saade) atom, hydrogen (jise protium kehte hain), ka nucleus hai. Proton par positive charge hai jis ka magnitude (miqdar) electron ke charge jitna hai (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C), aur us ka mass 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai. Neutron, jis ka pata 1932 mein James Chadwick ne lagaya, naam ke mutabiq electrically neutral (be-charge) hai aur us ka mass taqreeban proton jitna hai. Nucleus ke in dono particles (neutrons aur protons) ko nucleons kehte hain.

Hydrogen ke nucleus mein sirf ek proton hota hai, magar baqi sab elements ke nuclei mein neutrons aur protons dono hote hain. Alag alag nuclei ko nuclides kehte hain. Nucleus mein protons ki tadaad (number) atomic number hai, symbol (alamat) Z. Nucleons ki kul tadaad (neutrons + protons) ko A se likhte hain aur ise atomic mass number, ya sirf mass number, kehte hain. Neutrons ki tadaad:
Yahan N neutron number (neutrons ki tadaad) hai.

Kisi nucleus ko likhne ke liye ᴬ_Z X istemal hota hai: X element ka chemical symbol, oopar A (mass number) aur neeche Z (atomic number). Atomic particles ka mass kilogram ki bajaye unified mass scale (u) mein likhte hain. Definition (tareef) ke mutabiq 1 u carbon-12 atom ke mass ka theek barahwan (1/12) hissa hai: 1 u = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, jis ki energy 931 MeV ke barabar hai. Is unit mein proton ka mass 1.007276 u, neutron ka 1.008665 u aur electron ka 0.00055 u hai.

Kisi ek element (maslan carbon) ke nuclei mein protons ki tadaad hamesha ek jaisi hoti hai magar neutrons alag ho sakte hain. Carbon ke nuclei mein hamesha 6 protons hote hain, magar 6, 7 ya 8 neutrons ho sakte hain. Jin nuclei mein protons barabar magar neutrons alag hon, unhein isotopes kehte hain. Carbon ke isotopes ¹²₆C, ¹³₆C aur ¹⁴₆C hain; ¹²₆C aur ¹³₆C stable (paidar) hain, magar ¹⁴₆C unstable hai aur β particle (electron) aur ek neutrino jaisa particle (asal mein antineutrino) emit (bahar nikal) kar ke nitrogen ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi element ke alag alag isotopes mein kya common (ek jaisa) hai aur kya different (alag) (short question 12.1)? Woh element pehchaniye jis mein 87 nucleons aur 50 neutrons hain (short question 12.2).
blocks.explanation: Isotopes mein protons ki tadaad ek hai, to atomic number, electrons ki arrangement (tarteeb) aur chemistry ek hai; neutrons ki tadaad alag hai, to mass number, mass aur nuclear stability (paidari) alag (carbon-12 aur carbon-13 stable, carbon-14 radioactive). Z = A - N = 87 - 50 = 37: element rubidium hai, rubidium-87.

items: Nucleus: protons (+e, 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg) aur neutrons (neutral, Chadwick 1932), dono mil kar nucleons. Z = atomic number, A = mass number, N = A − Z (12.1); symbol ᴬ_Z X.
1 u = carbon-12 atom ka 1/12 = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg (931 MeV); proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, electron 0.00055 u. Isotopes: ek Z, alag N (¹²C, ¹³C, ¹⁴C; ¹⁴C beta decay se nitrogen).
